correctness.rationale: Nilpotence reduces modulo the nilpotent ideal tM_r(R); Smith normal form proves the single-Jordan criterion via nullity one; the determinant coefficient is a nonzero linear functional when the reduction is regular; finite-field exact counts follow. Nakayama lifting produces companion matrices. The entire GL_r(R) stabilizer has size (q−1)q^{rn−1} because an Fq-regular nilpotent has polynomial centralizer containing B. Scripts verify powers in five finite examples and full conjugacy in three cases. Standard Fine–Herstein nilpotent residue count is cited, not assumed novel.

value.rationale: The maximal Jordan stratum is the canonical dense nilpotent type inside the rectangular commuting variety. A uniform density independent of truncation n, together with exact full centralizer-orbit counts and an Eisenstein invariant, refines existence-only theory in a natural infinite family across every finite field and arbitrary multiplicity r. The n=2 case is acknowledged as previously partially covered, while n>=3 and complete rational orbit classification contribute additional structural and quantitative information.
